stages.stageDescription: Linux operating system, terminal navigation, shell scripting, and networking fundamentals.

items.whyRecommended: Linux powers virtually all cloud servers, containers, and deployment infrastructure.
practiceTasks: Write bash scripts for log rotation, disk space alerts, and process monitoring
items.projectApplication: Automated server health check script sending alerts on threshold violations
items.completionCriteria: Proficient with systemd, grep/awk/sed, file permissions (chmod/chown), and SSH keys

stages.stageDescription: Containerization, multi-stage builds, continuous integration, and infrastructure provisioning.

items.whyRecommended: Guarantees reproducible development and production deployment environments.
practiceTasks: Containerize multi-container web apps with databases and volume persistence
items.projectApplication: Dockerized microservices stack with isolated network bridges and healthchecks
items.completionCriteria: Production Docker images under 150MB with non-root security contexts

items.whyRecommended: Automates linting, testing, image building, and production deployment on every Git push.
practiceTasks: Build automated matrix workflows for linting, unit testing, and Docker image publishing to GHCR
items.projectApplication: Automated pull request validation workflow with preview deployments
items.completionCriteria: Automated pipeline blocks broken PRs and deploys green builds safely

stages.stageDescription: Kubernetes orchestration, pod scheduling, services, ingress, and Infrastructure as Code.

items.whyRecommended: Industry standard for orchestrating resilient distributed services at scale.
practiceTasks: Deploy a high-availability app on Minikube/K3s with HPA, ConfigMaps, and Ingress
items.projectApplication: Multi-tier app running in Kubernetes with automated horizontal pod autoscaling
items.completionCriteria: Simulate pod crash and verify zero-downtime traffic continuity

stages.stageDescription: Observability, distributed tracing, SRE practices, and chaos engineering.

items.whyRecommended: Essential for detecting service degradation and debugging production outages.

recommendedResources.title: Google SRE Book - Monitoring Distributed Systems

practiceTasks: Instrument Express/FastAPI apps with OpenTelemetry; configure Grafana dashboards and alert rules
items.projectApplication: Unified observability stack tracking P95/P99 latency, error rates, and saturation
items.completionCriteria: Alert fires accurately during simulated traffic spikes or high error rates

stages.stageDescription: Complete GitOps automated infrastructure pipeline deployed to public cloud.

items.whyRecommended: Demonstrates enterprise-grade automation and deployment hygiene.

items.projectApplication: Zero-touch deployment pipeline with blue/green deployment strategy
items.completionCriteria: Git commit automatically updates live production environment within 60 seconds

stages.stageDescription: SRE scenario troubleshooting, incident post-mortems, and system design.

items.whyRecommended: Primary evaluation criteria in DevOps/SRE interviews.
practiceTasks: Solve timed troubleshooting drills: DNS resolution failure, CrashLoopBackOff, disk space full
items.projectApplication: Write a formal blameless incident post-mortem with root cause analysis and action items
items.completionCriteria: Quickly isolate and explain the 4 Golden Signals (Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation)

stages.stageDescription: Cloud certifications preparation (AWS Solutions Architect / CKA) and public repository portfolio.

items.whyRecommended: High credibility booster for enterprise and consultancy hiring.
